title: Mexican Lentil Chilaquiles
description: A Mexican-inspired breakfast recipe featuring roasted lentils and crispy tortilla chips.
instructions: 2. In a large saucepan, heat the oil over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes.
3. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
4. Add the lentils, roasted tomatoes, cumin, chili powder, and salt. Stir to combine.
5. Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 20-25 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
6. Meanwhile, toss the chilaquiles with a little oil and spread on a baking sheet.
7. Roast the chilaquiles in the oven for 5-7 minutes, or until crispy.
8. To assemble the chilaquiles, place a scoop of the lentil mixture onto a plate, then top with the crispy chilaquiles and any desired toppings.
10. Garnish with fresh cilantro, lime wedges, and sour cream, if desired.
